content.purpose: Explains how to create, configure, test locally, and deploy Azure Static Web Apps, including optional Azure Functions APIs, with the SWA CLI.
content.whenToUse: Use it when you need help setting up local SWA development, configuring runtime behavior, connecting an API, or shipping a static site to Azure through CLI or GitHub Actions.
content.outputs: Returns concise guidance on the relevant SWA commands, configuration files, deployment flow, and common troubleshooting points for this workflow.
